maddeler.e:
نتناكح (form VI)
# نَتَنَاكَحُ (natanākaḥu) /na.ta.naː.ka.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاكَحَ (tanākaḥa)
# نَتَنَاكَحَ (natanākaḥa) /na.ta.naː.ka.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاكَحَ (tanākaḥa)
# نَتَنَاكَحْ (natanākaḥ) /na.ta.naː.kaħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاكَحَ (tanākaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
